description: This Java source file defines the class ThingEnforcementIdCacheLoader, which implements an asynchronous cache loader for loading entity ID relations related to authorization enforcement of 'Things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It primarily interacts with a shard region proxy to retrieve 'Thing' or 'Policy' entities and extracts relevant identifiers and revisions for caching.

classes.name: ThingEnforcementIdCacheLoader
classes.description: Implements an asynchronous cache loader to retrieve entity ID relations for 'Thing' enforcement, interacting with a shard proxy to fetch 'Thing' or 'Policy' entities and process responses accordingly.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous loading of cache entries for a given key using the delegate.

methods.name: handleSudoRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Processes the response from the 'sudoRetrieveThing' command, extracting the relevant ID, revision, and resource type, or handling errors and access issues.

methods.name: badThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a supplier that throws an IllegalStateException indicating a malformed or unexpected response.
